name: @veda-hq/agnipariksha
description: Mutation gate over stock StrykerJS: mutates the files a push changed, lane by lane, and blocks on a surviving mutant. Lanes come from agnipariksha.json. Also an arid-node ignorer plugin, @veda-hq/agnipariksha/arid-nodes, and the Stryker sandbox exclusions, @veda-hq/agnipariksha/sandbox-ignore.

scripts.smoke: out=$(node dist/bin.js --lane smoke-no-such-lane); code=$?; echo "$out"; case "$out" in *'REFUSED: --lane names no lane in agnipariksha.json: "smoke-no-such-lane" (its lanes: "agnipariksha"'*) [ $code = 2 ] ;; *) false ;; esac && node --input-type=module -e "const m = await import('@veda-hq/agnipariksha/arid-nodes'); const [p] = m.strykerPlugins; if (m.strykerPlugins.length !== 1 || p.kind !== 'Ignore' || p.name !== 'agnipariksha-arid-nodes' || typeof new p.injectableClass().shouldIgnore !== 'function') throw new Error('arid-nodes is not a Stryker Ignore plugin');" && node --input-type=module -e "const m = await import('@veda-hq/agnipariksha/sandbox-ignore'); if (m.MUTATION_IGNORE_PATTERNS.join(' ') !== 'dist build coverage node_modules .next ios android .stryker-tmp reports .tmp' || !Object.isFrozen(m.MUTATION_IGNORE_PATTERNS)) throw new Error('sandbox-ignore does not export the frozen ten-pattern MUTATION_IGNORE_PATTERNS');" && node --input-type=module -e "const { RETRY_PLUGIN } = await import('@veda-hq/agnipariksha/dist/lanes.js'); const { pathToFileURL } = await import('node:url'); const m = await import(pathToFileURL(RETRY_PLUGIN).href); const [p] = m.strykerPlugins; if (m.strykerPlugins.length !== 1 || p.kind !== 'Ignore' || p.name !== 'agnipariksha-retry' || typeof new p.injectableClass({}).shouldIgnore !== 'function') throw new Error('the retry ignorer RETRY_PLUGIN names is not a Stryker Ignore plugin');" && node --input-type=module -e "try { await import('@veda-hq/agnipariksha/dist/bin.js'); } catch (e) { if (e.code === 'ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED') process.exit(0); throw e; } throw new Error('dist/bin.js imports, and importing it would start a gate');"
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm smoke
